metadata.title: Threshold Career Path
metadata.note: stats/skills/ranks re-read from the PDF by position; lateral moves carried over from v1.1 (not on the sheet), sorted by name for ease of version comparison

careers.name: ARCHITECT
careers.description: The Architect is a visionary designer who shapes the physical world, creating structures that define cities and societies. Evolving from Engineers or Scientists, they possess high Intelligence and Education, allowing them to conceive and plan complex projects. Their skillset is focused on administration, bureaucracy, and technical skills like electrical and mechanical engineering, enabling them to oversee construction and manage resources. They are also skilled in persuasion and scanning, allowing them to negotiate with stakeholders and identify structural weaknesses. The Architect is the mastermind behind the skyline, turning dreams into reality.

careers.name: ARMS DEALER
careers.description: The Arms Dealer is a master of the black market, supplying weapons to armies, gangs, and rebels around the globe. Evolving from Smugglers, they possess high Intelligence, Education, and Charisma, allowing them to negotiate deals and manage logistics. Their skillset is focused on administration, bribery, and navigation, enabling them to transport weapons across borders and avoid detection. They are also skilled in psychology and persuasion, allowing them to build trust with clients and suppliers. The Arms Dealer is the engine of conflict, fueling wars with their wares.

careers.name: ATTORNEY
careers.description: The Attorney is a legal titan, a master of the law who can navigate the complexities of the judicial system with ease. Evolving from Lawyers, they possess high Intelligence, Education, and Charisma, allowing them to argue cases and persuade juries. Their skillset is focused on administration, persuasion, and law, enabling them to build airtight cases and dismantle opponents' arguments. They are also skilled in interrogation and psychology, allowing them to extract confessions and understand the motivations of witnesses. The Attorney is a shield and a sword, protecting the innocent and punishing the guilty.

careers.name: BLACKGUARD
careers.description: The Blackguard is the apex of the military and tactical armsman path, representing a highly trained operative who operates in the shadows for corporate interests or clandestine organizations. Having evolved from Commandos or Mercenaries, they combine elite combat proficiency with stealth and tactical genius. They are physically imposing with high Strength, Agility, and Endurance, making them nearly unstoppable in direct combat while remaining elusive enough to infiltrate secure facilities. Their skillset is a lethal blend of heavy weaponry mastery, advanced stealth, and survival tactics, allowing them to operate behind enemy lines for extended periods. Unlike standard soldiers, the Blackguard possesses a deep sense of Honor and Veteran experience, often serving as the final line of defense for high-value assets or the tip of the spear in covert operations.

careers.name: BODYGUARD
careers.description: The Bodyguard is a dedicated protector, sworn to safeguard the lives of high-profile individuals. Evolving from S.W.A.T. or Mercenaries, they possess high Strength, Endurance, and Initiative, making them formidable defenders. Their skillset is focused on combat, tactics, and psychology, enabling them to anticipate threats and neutralize them before they reach their charge. They are also skilled in first aid and intimidation, allowing them to provide medical care and deter attackers. The Bodyguard is a wall of steel, standing between their client and danger.

careers.name: BOUNTY HUNTER
careers.description: The Bounty Hunter is a specialized hunter who has transcended the role of a simple tracker to become a master of pursuit and capture. Evolving from Hunters or Detectives, they combine high-level investigative skills with deadly combat prowess to track down fugitives across any terrain. Their physical stats reflect a rugged endurance and agility, essential for chasing targets through urban sprawls or wildlands. They excel in interrogation, psychology, and stealth, allowing them to outthink and outmaneuver their prey before engaging. With advanced skills in Pistols, Melee, and Shadowing, they are relentless forces of law and order (or vigilante justice) who leave no stone unturned in their quest for the catch.

careers.name: CONSPIRACIST
careers.description: The Conspiracist is a unique hybrid of intellectual and operative, dedicated to uncovering and manipulating the hidden threads of power that control society. Rising from Detectives or Hunters, they possess a mind sharpened by extreme Intelligence and Education, allowing them to decode complex patterns and forge alliances in the shadows. Their skillset is heavily focused on stealth, forgery, disguise, and coding, making them a ghost in the machine of modern espionage. They are not just observers but active participants in the grand game of conspiracy, using their administrative and psychological skills to influence events from behind the scenes. Their existence is defined by the pursuit of truth in a world built on lies.

careers.name: CORONER
careers.description: The Coroner is a forensic expert who investigates the causes of death, uncovering the secrets hidden in the dead. Evolving from Doctors, they possess high Intelligence and Education, allowing them to analyze evidence and determine the manner of death. Their skillset is focused on pathology, surgery, and first aid, enabling them to perform autopsies and gather crucial evidence. They are also skilled in perception and treatment, allowing them to identify subtle clues and provide medical insights. The Coroner is the voice of the dead, speaking the truth that can bring justice to the living.

careers.name: CREW CHIEF
careers.description: The Crew Chief is the leader of a criminal crew, orchestrating complex heists and operations with precision. Evolving from Made Men or Sgts-at-Arms, they possess high Intelligence, Education, and Strength, allowing them to plan and execute daring schemes. Their skillset is focused on tactics, administration, and perception, enabling them to coordinate their team and anticipate obstacles. They are also skilled in combat and psychology, allowing them to lead by example and manage their crew's morale. The Crew Chief is the brain of the operation, turning chaos into a well-oiled machine.

careers.name: CYBERNETICIST
careers.summary: Master of Flesh and Machine / Bio-Engineer
careers.description: The Cyberneticist is a pioneer of the fusion between biology and technology, designing and implanting advanced cybernetic enhancements. Evolving from Ripperdocs or Engineers, they possess high Intelligence and Education, allowing them to understand the intricacies of both organic and mechanical systems. Their skillset is focused on cybernetics, surgery, and electronics, enabling them to create and install cutting-edge implants. They are also skilled in first aid and psychology, allowing them to care for patients and understand the psychological impact of augmentation. The Cyberneticist is the architect of the future, reshaping the human form.

careers.name: DEKKER
careers.description: The Dekker is a master hacker and netrunner, capable of penetrating the most secure digital systems. Evolving from Hackers or Techys, they possess high Intelligence, Education, and Initiative, allowing them to think and act faster than any firewall. Their skillset is focused on coding, integration, and system vulnerabilities, enabling them to breach defenses and steal data. They are also skilled in electronics and electrical engineering, allowing them to build and modify hardware. The Dekker is a ghost in the machine, invisible yet omnipresent in the digital realm.

careers.name: DENSETSUSHI
careers.description: The Densetsushi is a mythical figure in the streets, a warrior whose reputation precedes them as a master of urban combat and martial arts. Evolving from City Ronins, they represent the peak of physical perfection in a cyberpunk setting, blending traditional samurai honor with modern street ruthlessness. Their stats are incredibly high across the board, particularly in Agility and Initiative, making them the fastest and most reactive fighters on the battlefield. They are masters of melee combat, athletics, and intimidation, capable of dismantling entire squads with precision and speed. Their presence commands respect and fear, embodying the spirit of the lone wolf who fights for honor amidst the chaos of the city.

careers.name: EXORCIST
careers.description: The Exorcist is a holy warrior dedicated to cleansing the world of demonic and spiritual corruption. Evolving from Priests, they possess a deep connection to the divine, bolstered by high Willpower and Essence. Their skillset is focused on rituals, lore, and honor, allowing them to perform powerful banishments and exorcisms. They are skilled in administration and perception, enabling them to identify possessed individuals and navigate the complexities of religious institutions. Their presence brings hope to the afflicted and fear to the malevolent spirits they hunt. The Exorcist is a beacon of light in a world threatened by the darkness of the supernatural.

careers.name: FIXER
careers.description: The Fixer is a master of connections, able to get anything done in the criminal underworld. Evolving from Smugglers or Face, they possess high Intelligence, Education, and Charisma, allowing them to negotiate deals and resolve conflicts. Their skillset is focused on bribery, persuasion, and streetwise, enabling them to navigate the gray areas of the law. They are also skilled in psychology and intimidation, allowing them to manipulate others and enforce their will. The Fixer is the glue that holds the underworld together, solving problems that others cannot.

careers.name: FORGER
careers.description: The Forger is a master of deception, creating perfect replicas of documents, art, and identities. Evolving from Crooks or Grifters, they possess high Intelligence, Education, and Agility, allowing them to replicate even the most intricate details. Their skillset is focused on administration, bureaucracy, and coding, enabling them to bypass security systems and create flawless forgeries. They are also skilled in electronics and electrical engineering, allowing them to modify hardware and software. The Forger is a master of illusion, blurring the line between reality and fabrication.

careers.name: FUKUSHO
careers.description: The Fukusho is the right hand of a crime lord or military commander, a trusted lieutenant who manages operations and leads troops with unwavering loyalty and competence. Emerging from Street Samurai or City Ronin paths, they possess a rare combination of high physical stats and strong leadership qualities. Their skillset emphasizes administration, persuasion, and tactical combat, allowing them to coordinate complex operations and maintain order within their ranks. They are experts in melee and stealth, capable of handling personal threats while overseeing broader strategic goals. The Fukusho is the backbone of any organization, ensuring that the vision of their leader is executed flawlessly.

careers.name: GANGLEADER
careers.description: The Gangleader is the ruler of the streets, commanding a loyal following of thugs and enforcers. Evolving from Gangers or Shot Callers, they possess high Strength, Endurance, and Charisma, allowing them to lead their gang with authority. Their skillset is focused on intimidation, melee, and streetwise, enabling them to control their territory and crush rivals. They are also skilled in athletics and psychology, allowing them to inspire loyalty and fear. The Gangleader is a kingpin of the underworld, ruling with an iron fist.

careers.name: HIGH PRIESTESS
careers.description: The High Priestess is the matriarch of the Wiccan faith, a spiritual leader who guides her followers through the cycles of nature and magic. Evolving from Witches, she possesses immense wisdom and magical power, reflected in her high Intelligence, Willpower, and Essence. Her skillset is centered on ritual, lore, and persuasion, allowing her to lead ceremonies and teach the ways of the craft. She is also skilled in intimidation and streetwise, enabling her to protect her coven from external threats. The High Priestess is a figure of reverence and power, embodying the divine feminine and the mysteries of the earth.

careers.name: HITMAN
careers.description: The Hitman is a cold-blooded killer, hired to eliminate targets with precision and discretion. Evolving from Killers or City Ronins, they possess high Strength, Agility, and Endurance, making them deadly in combat. Their skillset is focused on stealth, pistols, and rifles, enabling them to assassinate targets from a distance or in close quarters. They are also skilled in disguise and psychology, allowing them to blend in and manipulate their victims. The Hitman is a ghost, appearing and disappearing without a trace, leaving only death in their wake.

careers.name: HOUNGANS/ MAMBOS
careers.description: The Houngans or Mambo is a revered leader in the Vodou tradition, a spiritual healer and medium who bridges the gap between the living and the spirits. Evolving from Hounsi, they possess deep knowledge of Vodou rituals and lore, supported by high Charisma and Intelligence. Their skillset is focused on ritual, persuasion, and intimidation, allowing them to command the loa and guide their community. They are also skilled in streetwise and perception, enabling them to navigate the complexities of the human spirit. The Houngans/Mambo is a pillar of their community, offering healing, guidance, and protection from the forces of evil.

careers.name: JOHNSON
careers.description: The Johnson is the mastermind behind criminal operations, coordinating teams and planning jobs with meticulous detail. Evolving from Smugglers or Faces, they possess high Intelligence, Education, and Charisma, allowing them to negotiate deals and manage resources. Their skillset is focused on administration, bureaucracy, and persuasion, enabling them to organize complex operations and avoid detection. They are also skilled in psychology and intimidation, allowing them to keep their team in line. The Johnson is the conductor of the orchestra, ensuring every note is played perfectly.

careers.name: MAGICIAN
careers.description: The Magician is the apex of Hermetic magic, a master of the arcane arts who has unlocked the deepest secrets of the universe. Evolving from Street Mages, they possess immense magical power, reflected in their high Intelligence, Education, and Essence. Their skillset is focused on ritual, lore, and persuasion, allowing them to perform complex spells and manipulate reality. They are also skilled in theft and streetwise, enabling them to acquire rare magical components and navigate the underworld. The Magician is a figure of mystery and power, wielding magic with precision and wisdom.

careers.name: MANAGEMENT
careers.description: The Management is the apex of corporate power, a leader who orchestrates the operations of massive organizations. Evolving from Businessmen or Corps, they possess high Intelligence, Education, and Charisma, allowing them to make strategic decisions and negotiate deals. Their skillset is focused on administration, bribery, and persuasion, enabling them to manipulate markets and influence politicians. They are also skilled in gambling and intimidation, allowing them to take risks and enforce their will. The Management is the puppet master, pulling the strings of the corporate world.

careers.name: MOB BOSS
careers.description: The Mob Boss is the ruler of organized crime, commanding a vast empire of illicit activities. Evolving from Made Men or Shot Callers, they possess high Intelligence, Education, and Charisma, allowing them to manage their organization and negotiate with rivals. Their skillset is focused on administration, bribery, and persuasion, enabling them to expand their influence and avoid law enforcement. They are also skilled in intimidation and psychology, allowing them to maintain control over their subordinates. The Mob Boss is a king of the underworld, ruling with an iron fist and a silver tongue.

careers.name: MONK
careers.description: The Monk is a master of physical and spiritual discipline, achieving a state of perfection through rigorous training and meditation. Evolving from Adepts, they possess incredible physical stats, particularly in Strength, Agility, and Endurance, reflecting their mastery of the body. Their skillset is focused on melee combat, athletics, and channeling physical energy, allowing them to fight with supernatural speed and power. They are also skilled in lore and honor, embodying the virtues of their order. The Monk is a living weapon, a testament to the power of the human spirit when unleashed from worldly constraints.

careers.name: OCCULTIST
careers.summary: Master of Forbidden Lore / Arcane Scholar
careers.description: The Occultist is a high-level intellectual who has dedicated their life to the study of the supernatural, ancient rituals, and hidden histories that lie beyond conventional understanding. Having typically advanced from Archaeologist or Historian, they serve as the ultimate bridge between academic theory and dangerous arcane practice, often operating in libraries, secret societies, or cursed sites to unlock secrets that could alter reality. They possess a formidable mind, bolstered by maximum Intelligence and Education stats, allowing them to process complex esoteric theories that would overwhelm lesser scholars. Their skillset is deeply rooted in the mastery of Ritual, Lore, and History, enabling them to perform powerful ceremonies, identify ancient threats, and navigate the intricate social hierarchies of both the academic and criminal underworlds. With extensive language proficiencies, including Latin and other obscure tongues, they can read texts that have been sealed for millennia. While they may lack the raw physical power of a combatant, their command over Admin, Perception, and Bribe ensures they can secure funding, gather intelligence, and manipulate factions to further their research. The Occultist is a figure of profound knowledge and potential danger, capable of unlocking powers that could save civilizations or tear them apart, often walking a fine line between revered scholar and feared practitioner of forbidden arts.

careers.name: OPERATOR
careers.summary: Special Forces Elite / Covert Action Specialist
careers.description: The Operator is the pinnacle of special forces training, a highly versatile soldier capable of executing the most dangerous missions with precision and efficiency. Evolving from Commandos, Mercenaries, or Borderguards, they are the go-to asset for governments and corporations needing results without trace. Their physical attributes are maximized for combat, with high Strength, Agility, and Endurance, ensuring they can endure the harshest conditions. Their skillset is a comprehensive mix of firearms mastery, stealth, tactics, and survival, making them adaptable to any scenario. They are the silent professionals who operate in the gray areas of conflict, leaving no evidence behind.

careers.name: POSSESSING SPIRIT
careers.description: The Possessing Spirit is a unique entity that exists beyond the physical realm, capable of inhabiting and controlling bodies. Unlike other channelers, they have no physical stats, relying entirely on their spiritual essence and mental power. Their skillset is focused on channeling spirit energy, rituals, and discipline, allowing them to possess hosts and manipulate the material world. They are skilled in lore and persuasion, enabling them to communicate with the living and guide their actions. The Possessing Spirit is a mysterious and powerful force, a reminder of the thin veil between life and death.

careers.name: PSYCHIC
careers.description: The Psychic is a master of the mind, possessing extraordinary mental abilities that allow them to perceive and manipulate thoughts and emotions. Evolving from Mediums, they have high Intelligence, Charisma, and Willpower, reflecting their mental prowess. Their skillset is focused on channeling mental energy, rituals, and perception, enabling them to read minds, predict the future, and influence others. They are also skilled in lore and first aid, allowing them to heal mental wounds and understand the workings of the psyche. The Psychic is a window into the soul, revealing the hidden truths of the human mind.

careers.name: RANGER
careers.description: The Ranger is the supreme master of the wild, a guardian who protects the borders between civilization and nature. Evolving from Trackers or Survivalists, they possess an unparalleled connection to the environment, allowing them to move unseen and strike from the shadows. Their physical stats emphasize endurance and strength, essential for surviving in hostile terrains. Their skillset is dominated by rifle mastery, stealth, and survival instincts, making them the ultimate hunters and trackers. They are also skilled in first aid and honor, often acting as the moral compass for groups venturing into the unknown. The Ranger is a solitary figure, respected for their ability to tame the untamed.

careers.name: RIGGER
careers.description: The Rigger is a master of remote-controlled vehicles and drones, capable of piloting machines from a safe distance. Evolving from DroneOps or Hackers, they possess high Intelligence, Education, and Agility, allowing them to think and react quickly. Their skillset is focused on integration, navigation, and electronics, enabling them to control fleets of drones and vehicles. They are also skilled in coding and mechanics, allowing them to modify and repair their machines. The Rigger is a puppeteer of the digital age, pulling the strings from afar.

careers.name: SEARCH& RESCUE
careers.summary: Elite Rescue Specialist / Disaster Response Expert
careers.description: The Search & Rescue specialist is a hero of the emergency services, trained to locate and extract individuals from the most perilous situations imaginable. Evolving from Borderguards or Trackers, they combine high-level combat skills with advanced medical and rescue techniques. Their stats reflect a need for agility and endurance to navigate disaster zones, while their initiative ensures quick decision-making in life-or-death scenarios. They are proficient in a wide array of skills, including scanning, piloting VTOLs, and first aid, making them indispensable in crisis management. Their dedication to saving lives sets them apart from other combat-focused armsmen, driven by a profound sense of duty.

careers.name: SKINWALKER
careers.description: The Skinwalker is a shapeshifter who can assume the form of animals or other beings, drawing power from tribal traditions and the natural world. Evolving from Shamans, they possess a unique blend of physical and spiritual attributes, allowing them to adapt to any situation. Their skillset is focused on channeling shamanic energy, rituals, and melee combat, enabling them to fight in any form. They are also skilled in lore, persuasion, and psychology, allowing them to navigate both the human and animal worlds. The Skinwalker is a trickster and a guardian, a creature of myth and legend.

careers.name: SURGEON
careers.description: The Surgeon is a medical virtuoso, a master of the operating room who can repair the most grievous injuries. Evolving from Doctors, they possess high Intelligence, Education, and Willpower, allowing them to perform complex procedures with precision. Their skillset is focused on surgery, first aid, and treatment, enabling them to save lives and restore health. They are also skilled in perception and focus, allowing them to maintain concentration during delicate operations. The Surgeon is a guardian of life, wielding the scalpel with the grace of an artist.

careers.name: TERRORIST
careers.description: The Terrorist is a radicalized operative who uses fear and violence as tools to achieve political or ideological ends. Evolving from Bombers or Commandos, they are masters of explosives, electronics, and asymmetric warfare. Their stats emphasize mental fortitude and physical agility, allowing them to execute complex attacks and evade capture. Their skillset is focused on ordnance, electrical engineering, and tactics, enabling them to create devastating devices and coordinate attacks. They are often driven by a strong will and charisma, able to inspire others to their cause. The Terrorist represents the dark side of revolutionary fervor, willing to sacrifice everything for their vision.

careers.name: THEORETICIST
careers.description: The Theoreticist is a scientist who pushes the boundaries of knowledge, developing groundbreaking theories that reshape our understanding of the universe. Evolving from Scientists, they possess high Intelligence and Education, allowing them to conceive abstract concepts and solve complex problems. Their skillset is focused on admin, scanning, and focus, enabling them to conduct research and analyze data. They are also skilled in coding, allowing them to simulate theories and model outcomes. The Theoreticist is the mind behind the discovery, the thinker who sees the patterns others miss.

careers.name: TOMB RAIDER
careers.description: The Tomb Raider is a daring explorer who seeks out ancient treasures and lost civilizations, braving the dangers of the past to uncover its secrets. Evolving from Archaeologists, they possess a unique blend of physical and intellectual attributes, allowing them to navigate treacherous ruins and decipher ancient codes. Their skillset is focused on scanning, perception, and lore, enabling them to find hidden chambers and identify valuable artifacts. They are also skilled in pistols, melee, and stealth, allowing them to defend themselves against traps and guardians. The Tomb Raider is a modern-day Indiana Jones, driven by the thrill of discovery.

careers.name: UNION AGENT
careers.description: The Union Agent is a fierce advocate for workers' rights, combining combat skills with bureaucratic expertise to protect laborers from corporate exploitation. Evolving from Detectives or Guards, they are skilled in negotiation, interrogation, and tactical combat. Their stats reflect a balance of physical strength and mental acuity, essential for navigating both the picket line and the boardroom. They are proficient in firearms, melee, and psychology, allowing them to defend their constituents effectively. Their administrative and bureaucracy skills enable them to organize strikes and negotiate contracts, making them a formidable force in the industrial landscape.

careers.name: WARDEN
careers.description: The Warden is a formidable keeper of order, responsible for managing high-security prisons or containing supernatural threats. Evolving from Hunters or Detectives, they possess a unique blend of combat, psychological, and ritualistic skills. Their stats emphasize physical strength and mental fortitude, allowing them to maintain control over dangerous inmates or entities. They are skilled in interrogation, stealth, and lore, enabling them to uncover secrets and prevent escapes. Their authority is absolute, backed by a deep understanding of human nature and the arcane. The Warden is a figure of immense responsibility, tasked with keeping the darkness at bay.

careers.name: YARD BOSS
careers.description: The Yard Boss is the ruler of the prison yard, commanding respect and fear from inmates and guards alike. Evolving from Shot Callers or Inmates, they possess high Strength, Endurance, and Willpower, allowing them to maintain order in the chaotic environment of a prison. Their skillset is focused on intimidation, interrogation, and melee, enabling them to enforce their rules and crush dissent. They are also skilled in administration and bribery, allowing them to manage resources and negotiate with authorities. The Yard Boss is a king in chains, ruling his domain with an iron fist.
